subject: [AMBER] Amber fails to compile with boost-1.88

messages.author: Charo del Genio
messages.body:
Dear all,
it appears that Amber(Tools) fails to compile if using the system installation of boost-1.88. The reason seems to be that the standard used within the code is c++11, whereas boost maths now requires
c++14 for some things. I tried passing -std=c++14 within CXXFLAGS in cmake, but it doesn't solve the problem.
An immediate workaround is to use the version of boost bundled with Amber, which, however, seems to be a bit outdated.
Are there any plans for the future to fix the standard of the code to c++14?
Cheers,
Charo
